name: daily-prayer
description: A Reformed daily prayer book. This folder holds the content, the build scripts and the shared code. The apps are in apps/.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/site install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.dev: npm run calendar && npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run calendar && tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:release: npm run calendar -- --release && tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.site: npm run build:release && npm --prefix apps/site run build && node scripts/merge-site.ts
scripts.mobile: npm run calendar -- --release && npm --prefix apps/mobile start
scripts.import: node scripts/import-1922.ts && node scripts/import-1662.ts && node scripts/import-psalter.ts
